munit:test.name: api-errors-maps-error-types-to-codes
munit:test.description: APP, APIKIT and DB error types map to catalogue codes; anything else is INTERNAL_ERROR

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import codeFor from dwl::ApiErrors output application/json --- { duplicate: codeFor({ namespace: "APP", identifier: "DUPLICATE_PATIENT" }), notFound: codeFor({ namespace: "APP", identifier: "PATIENT_NOT_FOUND" }), badRequest: codeFor({ namespace: "APIKIT", identifier: "BAD_REQUEST" }), dbDown: codeFor({ namespace: "DB", identifier: "CONNECTIVITY" }), dbQuery: codeFor({ namespace: "DB", identifier: "QUERY_EXECUTION" }), unknownApp: codeFor({ namespace: "APP", identifier: "SOMETHING_ELSE" }), expression: codeFor({ namespace: "MULE", identifier: "EXPRESSION" }) }

munit:test.name: api-errors-statuses-follow-the-assignment-table
munit:test.description: Each code carries the HTTP status from the assignment's error table

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import statusFor from dwl::ApiErrors output application/json --- ["BAD_REQUEST", "PATIENT_NOT_FOUND", "DUPLICATE_PATIENT", "INVALID_BIRTH_DATE", "CONSENT_REQUIRED", "DOWNSTREAM_ERROR", "INTERNAL_ERROR", "NOT_A_CODE"] map statusFor($)

munit:test.name: api-errors-builds-standard-body-in-utc
munit:test.description: The error body has the four standard fields and a UTC timestamp regardless of the input offset

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import errorBody from dwl::ApiErrors output application/json --- errorBody("DUPLICATE_PATIENT", "6f1c2a9e-0b7d-4c1e-9a52-3c4d5e6f7a8b", |2026-10-15T12:21:07.345+02:00|)

munit:test.name: patient-records-insert-parameters-bind-null-for-absent-phone
munit:test.description: An absent phone becomes a NULL parameter; every other field is passed through

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import toInsertParameters from dwl::PatientRecords output application/java --- toInsertParameters(readUrl("classpath://samples/record-input.json", "application/json") - "phone")

munit:test.name: patient-records-row-maps-to-record-contract
munit:test.description: A selected row maps to the record contract with a UTC registered_at and no internal columns

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import fromRow from dwl::PatientRecords output application/json --- { withPhone: fromRow(readUrl("classpath://samples/patient-row.json", "application/json")), withoutPhone: fromRow((readUrl("classpath://samples/patient-row.json", "application/json") - "phone") ++ { phone: null }) }

munit:test.name: log-event-is-a-single-line-json-object
munit:test.description: LogEvent.event: event name and correlation ID first, then the fields, on one line

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import event, elapsedMillis from dwl::LogEvent output application/json var message = event("response.sent", "cid-1", { status: 201, path: "/api/patients" }) --- { message: message, parsed: read(message, "application/json"), oneLine: not (message contains "\n"), elapsedIsNonNegative: elapsedMillis(now() as Number { unit: "milliseconds" }) >= 0 }
